categories.title: Operation Theatre Equipment
categories.description: Complete Operation Theatre solutions designed for precision, reliability, and surgeon comfort. Our OT equipment range includes state-of-the-art surgical lights, versatile operating tables, and advanced anesthesia systems that meet international standards.

instruments.name: LED Surgical Lights
instruments.description: High-intensity LED surgical lights providing shadow-free illumination with adjustable color temperature (3500K-5000K). Features include touchless on/off sensors, multiple dome configurations, and integrated HD camera options for documentation and teaching purposes.

instruments.name: OT Tables (Hydraulic & Electric)
instruments.description: Precision-engineered operating tables with hydraulic and electric positioning systems. Offers multi-axis movement including Trendelenburg, lateral tilt, and height adjustment. Radiolucent tabletop allows intraoperative imaging without repositioning the patient.

instruments.name: Surgical Pendants
instruments.description: Ceiling-mounted surgical pendants providing organized gas supply, electrical outlets, and data connections at the point of care. Rotatable arms with adjustable height ensure optimal positioning while maintaining a clutter-free operating environment.

instruments.name: Electrosurgical Units
instruments.description: Advanced electrosurgical generators offering precise cutting and coagulation modes with power outputs ranging from 1-400W. Features include vessel sealing technology, smoke evacuation, and safety systems to prevent unintended tissue damage.

instruments.name: Anesthesia Workstations
instruments.description: Fully integrated anesthesia delivery systems with electronic gas mixing, advanced ventilation modes, and comprehensive patient monitoring. Equipped with agent-specific vaporizers, circle breathing systems, and automated self-test functionality for enhanced safety.

instruments.name: OT Room Sterilizers
instruments.description: Hospital-grade sterilization systems including plasma, ETO, and steam sterilizers designed for surgical instruments and sensitive medical devices. Features rapid cycle times, biological indicator integration, and full traceability with digital record keeping.

categories.title: ICU Equipment
categories.description: Advanced Intensive Care Unit equipment for critical patient monitoring and life support. Our ICU solutions integrate seamlessly to provide comprehensive care management for critically ill patients with real-time data connectivity.

instruments.name: ICU Beds (Motorized)
instruments.description: Fully motorized ICU beds with intuitive controls for precise patient positioning. Features include integrated weighing scale, CPR quick-release, lateral tilt therapy, and programmable Trendelenburg positions. Anti-microbial surfaces ensure infection control compliance.

instruments.name: Ventilators
instruments.description: Invasive and non-invasive ventilators supporting all modes including volume control, pressure control, SIMV, CPAP, and BiPAP. High-resolution waveform displays, lung mechanics monitoring, and smart alarms ensure precise respiratory support for critically ill patients.

instruments.name: Patient Monitors
instruments.description: Multi-parameter bedside monitors tracking ECG, SpO2, NIBP, IBP, temperature, EtCO2, and cardiac output. Features include arrhythmia analysis, ST-segment monitoring, drug calculation, and seamless integration with central monitoring stations and EMR systems.

instruments.name: Infusion Pumps
instruments.description: Precision volumetric infusion pumps with dose error reduction systems and extensive drug libraries. Supports micro-infusion rates from 0.1 mL/hr with ±2% accuracy. Features include air-in-line detection, occlusion alarms, and wireless connectivity for centralized monitoring.

instruments.name: Syringe Pumps
instruments.description: High-precision syringe pumps designed for accurate delivery of critical medications at ultra-low flow rates. Compatible with all standard syringe sizes (5-60mL), featuring bolus delivery, pressure monitoring, and stackable design for multi-channel applications.

instruments.name: Defibrillators
instruments.description: Biphasic defibrillators with synchronized cardioversion, AED mode, and manual override capabilities. Features include 12-lead ECG, SpO2 monitoring, built-in printer, and advanced CPR feedback technology to guide rescuers during resuscitation efforts.

categories.title: NICU Equipment
categories.description: Specialized neonatal intensive care equipment engineered for the most vulnerable patients. Our NICU solutions provide precise temperature control, gentle ventilation, and comprehensive monitoring to support premature and critically ill newborns.

instruments.name: Baby Warmers (Radiant)
instruments.description: Open-care radiant warmers with servo-controlled heating maintaining precise skin temperature. Features include integrated pulse oximetry, phototherapy provision, resuscitation platform, and tilting bassinet. Provides 360° access for procedures while maintaining thermal stability.

instruments.name: Phototherapy Units
instruments.description: High-intensity LED phototherapy systems delivering optimal blue-light spectrum (420-490nm) for effective treatment of neonatal jaundice. Features include adjustable irradiance levels, compact overhead and underneath configurations, and treatment hour counter for protocol management.

instruments.name: Infant Incubators
instruments.description: Microprocessor-controlled incubators providing precise temperature, humidity, and oxygen environment for premature infants. Features servo and air mode temperature control, double-wall construction for minimal heat loss, and integrated weighing for growth monitoring.

instruments.name: Neonatal Ventilators
instruments.description: Specialized ventilators designed for the delicate lungs of neonates, supporting conventional and high-frequency ventilation modes. Ultra-sensitive flow sensors detect minimal respiratory efforts, while volume guarantee ensures consistent tidal volumes for lung-protective ventilation.

instruments.name: Pulse Oximeters (Neonatal)
instruments.description: Neonatal-specific pulse oximeters with motion-resistant technology and specialized sensors designed for tiny fingers and toes. Features include perfusion index monitoring, signal quality indicators, and customizable alarm limits for preterm and term neonates.

instruments.name: Transport Incubators
instruments.description: Portable incubator systems designed for safe inter-hospital and intra-hospital transport of critically ill neonates. Battery-operated with integrated ventilator, monitor, and infusion pump mounts. Vibration-dampening suspension protects fragile infants during transit.

categories.title: Physiotherapy Equipment
categories.description: Complete physiotherapy and rehabilitation equipment for recovery, pain management, and wellness. Our range covers electrotherapy, mechanical therapy, exercise equipment, and hydrotherapy solutions for comprehensive rehabilitation programs.

instruments.name: Short Wave Diathermy
instruments.description: Therapeutic short wave diathermy units generating deep tissue heating at 27.12 MHz frequency. Offers both continuous and pulsed modes with adjustable power output. Capacitive and inductive applicators provide targeted treatment for musculoskeletal conditions and chronic pain.

instruments.name: Ultrasound Therapy Units
instruments.description: Therapeutic ultrasound systems operating at 1 MHz and 3 MHz frequencies for deep and superficial tissue treatment. Features continuous and pulsed wave modes with adjustable intensity (0.1-3.0 W/cm²). Promotes tissue healing, reduces inflammation, and relieves pain.

instruments.name: TENS / EMS Machines
instruments.description: Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation (TENS) and Electrical Muscle Stimulation (EMS) combination units for pain relief and muscle rehabilitation. Multiple preset programs with customizable parameters including frequency, pulse width, and intensity for personalized treatment.

instruments.name: Cervical & Lumbar Traction
instruments.description: Electronic traction systems providing controlled intermittent and sustained cervical and lumbar traction. Programmable force profiles with gradual ramp-up ensure patient comfort. Digital displays show real-time force, treatment time, and cycle parameters for precise therapy delivery.

instruments.name: Exercise Equipment
instruments.description: Professional-grade rehabilitation exercise equipment including parallel bars, shoulder wheels, finger ladders, pedal exercisers, and balance boards. Designed for progressive resistance training and functional recovery in physiotherapy departments and rehabilitation centers.

instruments.name: Wax Bath Units
instruments.description: Thermostatically controlled paraffin wax bath units maintaining optimal temperature (52-54°C) for thermotherapy. Provides deep, moist heat to hands, feet, and joints for pain relief and improved mobility. Features rapid melting, temperature lock, and large capacity tanks.

categories.title: Patient Monitoring Systems
categories.description: Real-time patient monitoring systems for accurate vital sign tracking across all hospital departments. From bedside monitors to central stations, our systems provide continuous surveillance with intelligent alarm management and clinical decision support.

instruments.name: Multi-Parameter Monitors
instruments.description: Comprehensive bedside monitors displaying ECG, SpO2, NIBP, temperature, respiration rate, and optional IBP, EtCO2, and cardiac output parameters. High-resolution touchscreens with customizable layouts, 72-hour trend storage, and network connectivity for seamless data sharing.

instruments.name: ECG Machines (12 Channel)
instruments.description: 12-channel diagnostic ECG machines with automatic interpretation, high-resolution thermal printing, and digital storage. Features include resting ECG, stress test protocols, and Holter analysis capabilities. Lightweight portable design enables bedside and clinic use.

instruments.name: Pulse Oximeters
instruments.description: Medical-grade pulse oximeters providing accurate SpO2 and pulse rate measurement with advanced signal processing technology. Available in fingertip, handheld, and tabletop configurations. Features include plethysmograph waveform display, perfusion index, and adjustable alarm settings.

instruments.name: Blood Pressure Monitors
instruments.description: Clinical-grade automatic blood pressure monitors using oscillometric measurement with intelligent cuff inflation. Features include irregular heartbeat detection, multiple user memory, averaging function, and validation against mercury sphygmomanometer standards.

instruments.name: Fetal Monitors
instruments.description: Cardiotocography (CTG) systems for continuous fetal heart rate and uterine contraction monitoring during pregnancy and labor. Features include twin monitoring, wireless transducers, automatic fetal movement detection, and advanced analysis algorithms for fetal well-being assessment.

instruments.name: Central Monitoring Systems
instruments.description: Networked central monitoring stations displaying real-time data from multiple bedside monitors simultaneously. Features include full disclosure waveform review, alarm escalation protocols, nurse call integration, and remote viewing capabilities for physician oversight.

categories.title: Surgical & Diagnostic Instruments
categories.description: Precision surgical instruments and diagnostic equipment manufactured from premium-grade stainless steel. Our instruments undergo rigorous quality checks to ensure reliability, durability, and optimal performance across various surgical specialties.

instruments.name: Suction Machines
instruments.description: High-vacuum surgical suction apparatus with adjustable vacuum pressure from 0-760 mmHg. Features include overflow protection, bacterial filter, autoclavable collection jars, and foot-pedal operation. Available in portable and wall-mounted configurations for versatile placement.

instruments.name: Cautery Machines
instruments.description: Electrocautery and radiofrequency cautery units for precise tissue cutting and hemostasis. Features include monopolar and bipolar modes, adjustable power settings, and specialized handpieces for different surgical applications. Built-in safety systems prevent accidental activation.

instruments.name: Boyles Apparatus
instruments.description: Classic Boyle's anesthesia machine with continuous flow gas delivery system, precision vaporizers, and circle breathing system. Features include oxygen failure alarm, anti-hypoxia device, and pin-index cylinder yokes. Robust design suitable for hospitals with intermittent power supply.

instruments.name: Autoclave Sterilizers
instruments.description: High-pressure steam sterilization systems operating at 121-134°C for complete microbial elimination. Available in horizontal, vertical, and tabletop configurations. Features include automatic cycle control, drying cycles, and validation ports for biological indicator testing.

instruments.name: Surgical Instrument Sets
instruments.description: Complete surgical instrument sets for general surgery, orthopedics, gynecology, and specialty procedures. Manufactured from German-grade stainless steel with mirror and satin finishes. Each set includes retractors, forceps, scissors, needle holders, and specialty instruments.

instruments.name: ENT Diagnostic Sets
instruments.description: Comprehensive ENT examination and diagnostic sets including otoscopes, ophthalmoscopes, nasal speculums, and laryngeal mirrors. LED illumination provides clear visualization. Wall-mounted and portable options available for OPD clinics and bedside examination.

categories.title: Hospital Furniture
categories.description: Ergonomic and durable hospital furniture designed for patient comfort, staff efficiency, and infection control. Our furniture range combines robust construction with modern aesthetics, meeting healthcare facility standards for safety and hygiene.

instruments.name: Hospital Beds (Manual & Electric)
instruments.description: Versatile hospital beds available in manual crank and fully electric configurations. Features include adjustable head and foot sections, collapsible side rails, IV pole mounts, and castor wheels with central locking. Anti-microbial powder coating ensures long-lasting hygiene.

instruments.name: Examination Tables
instruments.description: Sturdy examination tables with adjustable backrest, padded upholstery, and paper roll holder. Available in fixed-height and hydraulic lift models. Features include stirrup attachments for gynecological examination, storage drawers, and easy-clean antimicrobial surfaces.

instruments.name: Stretchers & Trolleys
instruments.description: Patient transport stretchers and emergency trolleys with adjustable height, oxygen cylinder holder, IV rod, and four-sided collapsible railings. Lightweight aluminum construction with shock-absorbing wheels ensures smooth patient transfer across hospital floors.

instruments.name: Bedside Lockers
instruments.description: Compact bedside lockers with multiple compartments, overbed table attachment, and lockable cabinet. Made from pre-laminated board or stainless steel with anti-bacterial coating. Features include built-in electrical outlets and adjustable shelves for patient convenience.

instruments.name: IV Stands & Instrument Trolleys
instruments.description: Height-adjustable IV stands with multiple hooks and stable five-leg base. Instrument trolleys feature stainless steel construction with two or three shelves, drawer options, and push handle. Easy-rolling castors with brake function for secure positioning.

instruments.name: Wheelchairs
instruments.description: Durable wheelchairs in standard, lightweight, and reclining configurations. Chrome-plated steel frames with detachable footrests, flip-back armrests, and pneumatic rear tires. Foldable design for easy storage and transport. Weight capacity options from 100kg to 150kg.

categories.title: Laboratory Equipment
categories.description: Modern laboratory equipment for accurate diagnostics, research, and clinical testing. Our lab solutions support pathology, biochemistry, microbiology, and hematology departments with reliable, calibrated instruments meeting international quality standards.

instruments.name: Microscopes
instruments.description: Research and clinical-grade microscopes with LED illumination, multiple objective lenses (4x to 100x oil immersion), and binocular/trinocular heads. Features include Koehler illumination, mechanical stage with vernier scales, and optional digital camera for image capture and documentation.

instruments.name: Centrifuges
instruments.description: Laboratory centrifuges with variable speed control (500-15000 RPM) and programmable time settings. Available in micro, clinical, and refrigerated models. Features include imbalance detection, auto-lid lock, and multiple rotor options for different tube sizes and sample volumes.

instruments.name: Blood Analyzers
instruments.description: Automated hematology analyzers providing complete blood count (CBC) with 3-part or 5-part differential. Processes 60-120 samples per hour with parameters including WBC, RBC, HGB, HCT, PLT, and reticulocyte count. Features include auto-sampling, QC management, and LIS connectivity.

instruments.name: Biochemistry Analyzers
instruments.description: Semi-automatic and fully automatic biochemistry analyzers for comprehensive metabolic panels. Measures liver function, kidney function, lipid profile, glucose, and electrolytes. Features include open reagent system, barcode reader, and throughput of 100-400 tests per hour.

instruments.name: Refrigerators (Medical Grade)
instruments.description: Purpose-built medical refrigerators with precise temperature control (2-8°C) for vaccine, blood, and reagent storage. Features include digital temperature display, audible/visual alarms, data logging, forced-air circulation, and battery backup for power failure protection.

instruments.name: Water Bath Units
instruments.description: Thermostatically controlled water baths with temperature range from ambient to 100°C and accuracy of ±0.5°C. Stainless steel chambers with concentric ring covers minimize evaporation. Available in various capacities from 5 to 28 liters for different laboratory applications.
